Respiratory end-tidal reference 35–45 mmHg; baseline, upstroke, plateau and inspiration. NG signals may be diluted or absent.
Example pump range 1–400 mL/hr; stated accuracy ±5%; downstream occlusion 83 ±21 kPa. None is a universal normal tube pressure.
Continuity and hydrostatic head. Loss model adds assumed viscous resistance and neglects kinetic-head change.

use_and_limit: Prospective research comparing gastric, oesophageal, saliva and bronchial pH. Included to represent ambiguity rather than perfect separation.
Gastric pH may be elevated by feeding and acid suppression; elevated pH does not prove the tip is outside the stomach.
